desc: While coming back from his mission, Naruto recollects his strange encounter with Itachi. As Naruto wonders about this, Kakashi decides to make an abrupt visit.

desc: Naruto wanders the streets of the Leaf Village in deep grief over Jiraiya's passing. He reflects on his memories with his former master to find the strength to move forward.

title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Naruto Uzumaki, a headstrong adolescent who seeks approval and acceptance, trains to overcome various challenges and become the village Hokage.

title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Naruto begins his sage jutsu training at Mount Myoboku under Fukasaku. But his first challenge is not to move as Fukasaku explains that a lot of time is needed in order to harness nature energy.

title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Naruto goes back to Mount Myoboku to continue his Sage training, but it progresses very slowly. This annoys Fukasaku, and he suggests that they move on to the next training exercise.

desc: Shikamaru and the team wait for the analysis on the information Jiraiya brought back. But just as the Hidden Leaf ninja perform their data analysis, disaster strikes the village.

desc: Pain and Konan come down with a heavy attack on the Leaf Village. So, Tsunade tries to contact Fukasaku to get Naruto on the battlefield.

desc: Led into battle against the Deva Path, Kakashi attempts to strike it with his chidori. However, Pain disrupts his technique.

desc: Naruto is left to wonder on Mount Myoboku if the Akatsuki would ever launch an offensive on Konoha just in order to find him.

desc: Ebisu shields Konohamaru from Pain's attacks and tries to keep him safe. But upon seeing his teacher risk his life to save him, he decides to fight by using the 'rasengan' technique Naruto taught him.
